title: Chicken tikka masala
steps: Toss chicken with yogurt, 1 tsp garam masala, paprika, half the garlic, and salt. Marinate 20 minutes.
Sear chicken until browned; it can finish in the sauce.
Cook onion in oil until golden. Add remaining garlic, cumin, and garam masala.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in cream and chicken; simmer until thick.
